title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 (Fort Mason, San Francisco) — keynote livestreamed, same day as CoreWeave Fully Connected day 1
source: EST: devday.openai.com, fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200), which reads verbatim 'OpenAI DevDay is on September 29, 2026 at Fort Mason in San Francisco' and states the keynote is livestreamed free and open to everyone. The company's own announcement post, openai.com/index/devday-2026/, returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch this session and is recorded in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked; events.openai.com/devdayexchange2026 returned 202 and separately lists the DevDay Exchange series (Bengaluru 10-16, Tokyo 10-20, Seoul 10-22, Berlin 10-26, Paris 10-28, London 11-03, Sao Paulo 11-06, Mexico City 11-10), which corroborates a 2026 DevDay program anchored on the SF date. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: OpenAI is a private company, so market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for it (IR: is an issuer prefix and OpenAI files nothing) - the same schema gap jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 both recorded for non-issuer publishers - and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: DISCOVERED IN THE crwv-fully-connected-2026-09-29 D-14 ADJACENCY SWEEP (2026-09-15), and proposed for an ATTRIBUTION reason of an unusually direct kind. OpenAI is CoreWeave's largest disclosed customer - approximately $22.4B of contracted compute across the March 2025 ($11.9B), May 2025 ($4B) and September 2025 ($6.5B) agreements, all on investors.coreweave.com - and DevDay is the one day a year OpenAI concentrates its model and platform announcements. It now falls on 2026-09-29, in San Francisco, the same day and the same city as day 1 of CoreWeave's own Fully Connected 2026 at Moscone South. The proposing ledger's whole stance rests on the claim that no CRWV move in the 09-29..10-02 window is attributable to the conference; this makes that claim stronger and the window worse, because a CRWV tape move on 09-29 now has a second same-day AI-narrative source whose subject is CoreWeave's own demand curve. The channel is real but UNMEASURED: no house playbook is keyed to a private company's developer conference, there is no OpenAI security to price, and this calendar has never studied a DevDay. Impact is tiered medium rather than high on exactly that ground - the read-through to CRWV is a narrative channel with n=0 measured instances, not a print. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action, and nothing here changes the proposing ledger's watch-only stance. A second, unmeasured read-through runs to NVDA, which is not listed in symbols because no relationship has been measured. See docs/research/events/crwv-fully-connected-2026-09-29.md.
